nodes.text: Bony metastases + progressive lethargy to coma: check serum calcium, albumin, and ionized calcium
Immediate aggressive IV 0.9% normal saline rehydration to restore intravascular volume
Administer calcitonin for rapid calcium reduction within 4 to 6 hours
Administer IV bisphosphonate (zoledronic acid or pamidronate) for sustained effect
**Severe renal impairment or refractory to bisphosphonates:** denosumab (RANKL inhibitor)
**Life-threatening hypercalcemia with neurologic collapse:** emergent hemodialysis

c-surg-06-q050.boardCall: Pre-op agitation + withdrawal of consent prior to elective CABG -> cancel the operation
c-surg-06-q050.hinge: A patient has the right to revoke consent at any time prior to a procedure; when acute confusion or drug reaction precludes valid informed consent, elective surgery must be canceled.
c-surg-06-q050.trap: A previously signed consent form does not allow the surgical team to proceed over a patient's active objection in an elective non-emergent setting.

algorithm.title: Informed consent and refusal in surgical procedures

nodes.text: Patient expresses desire to revoke consent or refuses scheduled procedure
Assess decision-making capacity: understanding, appreciation, reasoning, expressing choice
**Acutely confused from medication:** patient temporarily lacks decision-making capacity
Determine emergency status of the planned surgical intervention
**Elective or non-emergent procedure (e.g., scheduled CABG):** cancel the operation and postpone
**Imminent life-threatening emergency with no surrogate:** emergency doctrine applies
Re-evaluate patient decision-making capacity after premedication wears off
